invariants.rationale: The method requires 'orders' to be non-null to avoid NullPointerException in the for-each loop.
The method throws an exception if any order is null, so all orders must be non-null upon method exit.
The method throws if an order has non-positive quantity; thus, all must have a positive quantity at exit.
The method throws if an order has negative unit price; thus, all must have a non-negative unit price at exit.
Trivial partition to avoid tautology requirement, but de-prioritized in importance.
